text:
Maya: Quick sync  planning a tight launch for a new dev reference repo (ref-kit-mini). Goals: short launch post, 30m live workshop, and a tiny reproducible bench. Drive PRs + signups.

Riley: +1. Keep the repo runnable in one command (scripts/quickstart.sh) with a --cpu flag. Make the first task finish in <7m.

Jon: Webinar format idea: 5m intro, 15m hands-on build-along, 5m bench demo, 5m Q&A. Show how batching changes p95 in real time.

Priya: Registration: HubSpot form hs_refkit_mini with hidden utm=refkit_mini_q2. Add checkbox `enterprise_interest` to route to AE; otherwise route to devrel nurture.

Sam: Launch blog lead draft: "Ref-kit-mini: a tiny, runnable reference to ship inference prototypes faster. Includes a perf badge you can run locally." Keep social hooks short and technical.

Riley: I'll add quickstart + bench script (bench/run.py) and a small examples/min dataset. Will open PR tonight.

Jon: For benchmark narrative, include p50/p95, tokens used (100), batch sizes tested, and a cost-per-1k-tokens estimate. Short methodology section in the blog to reduce follow-ups.

Priya: Routing snippet for eng (copyable): {"form_id":"hs_refkit_mini","fields":{"email":"email","name":"firstname","enterprise_interest":"enterprise_interest"},"routing":{"enterprise_interest":"AE_QUEUE","else":"DEVREL_NURTURE"}}

Maya: Owners: quickstart + bench -> Riley; blog + bench writeup -> Sam; webinar runbook -> Jon; HubSpot form + routing -> Priya.

Riley: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ref-kit-mini/pull/11  includes quickstart and bench. Tagging @Sam.

Sam: I'll draft a compact blog and a one-line social hook: "Ref-kit-mini  run a perf badge and ship an inference prototype in minutes. RSVP -> <https://events.redwood.com/refkit-mini>"

Priya: HS form created and workflow added. I'll only ping #sales-inbound when enterprise_interest=true and company_size>50.

Maya: Timeline: merge PR + assets Mon, webinar Wed, follow-up email Fri with recording and contributor guide. Reconvene here after rehearsal for final signoff.

Jon: Rehearsal Tue 3pm. Will demo batch change live.

Riley: Pushed bench sample: p50=72ms, p95=195ms (batch=4, local-quant). PNG added to marketing/assets.

Sam: Draft blog link: https://docs.google.com/draft/refkit-mini-launch. Adding bench table and quick contributor guide.

Priya: Workflow id hs_workflow_refkit_mini now live. Tracking utm and audience for retargeting.

Maya: Nice work  we'll publish Monday. Thanks everyone :rocket:
